tweet.text:
I joined crypto in '19,

Lost it all in perps and casinos, left.

I re-joined crypto in '21,

Made my first $800k.

Lost almost 75% of it during '22 bear-market.

Didn't quit this time, instead, I accumulated knowledge.

Went hard on the first shitcoin season, made $1m3 in '23,

Kept most of it in stables, so I could work stress-free this whole '24 year.

Result is we only at the half of the year and I already made the same amount I made in '23.

Heading for a $3m net this year if god's will.

Lesson in there: have to take profits.
